metadata.title: Supabase Integration Introduction
metadata.description: Learn how to integrate Supabase Authentication with the Capacitor Social Login plugin for a complete authentication solution.

blocks.text: This tutorial will guide you through setting up Supabase Authentication with the Capacitor Social Login plugin. This integration allows you to use native social login providers (Google, Apple, Facebook, Twitter) on mobile platforms while leveraging Supabase Auth for backend authentication and PostgreSQL for data storage.
